name: doguclks-mods
description: Claude Code mods: Turkish replies, a done notification, and a shield for dangerous commands.

plugins.name: turkish-mode
plugins.description: Makes Claude reply in Turkish; toggle it with /turkish.

plugins.name: done-notify
plugins.description: Plays a sound, flashes the terminal and leaves a Windows notification when a long turn finishes.

plugins.name: command-shield
plugins.description: Asks you before Claude runs a dangerous Bash or PowerShell command.
